17: package sqlserver
18: 
19: import (
20: 	"context"
21: 	"fmt"
22: 	"io"
23: 	"net"
24: 	"strconv"
25: 
26: 	mssql "github.com/denisenkom/go-mssqldb"
27: 	"github.com/denisenkom/go-mssqldb/azuread"
28: 	"github.com/denisenkom/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
29: 	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
30: 	"github.com/jcmturner/gokrb5/v8/client"
31: 
32: 	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/auth"
33: 	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/common"
34: 	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/sqlserver/protocol"
35: )
36: 
37: // Connector defines an interface for connecting to a SQL Server so it can be
38: // swapped out in tests.
39: type Connector interface {
40: 	Connect(context.Context, *common.Session, *protocol.Login7Packet) (io.ReadWriteCloser, []mssql.Token, error)
41: }
42: 
43: type connector struct {
44: 	// Auth is the database auth client
45: 	DBAuth common.Auth
46: 	// AuthClient is the teleport client
47: 	AuthClient auth.ClientI
48: 	// DataDir is the Teleport data directory
49: 	DataDir string
50: }
51: 
52: // Connect connects to the target SQL Server with Kerberos authentication.
53: func (c *connector) Connect(ctx context.Context, sessionCtx *common.Session, loginPacket *protocol.Login7Packet) (io.ReadWriteCloser, []mssql.Token, error) {
54: 	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(sessionCtx.Database.GetURI())
55: 	if err != nil {
56: 		return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
57: 	}
58: 
59: 	portI, err := strconv.ParseUint(port, 10, 64)
60: 	if err != nil {
61: 		return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
62: 	}
63: 
64: 	tlsConfig, err := c.DBAuth.GetTLSConfig(ctx, sessionCtx)
65: 	if err != nil {
66: 		return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
67: 	}
68: 
69: 	// Pass all login options from the client to the server.
70: 	options := msdsn.LoginOptions{
71: 		OptionFlags1: loginPacket.OptionFlags1(),
72: 		OptionFlags2: loginPacket.OptionFlags2(),
73: 		TypeFlags:    loginPacket.TypeFlags(),
74: 	}
75: 
76: 	dsnConfig := msdsn.Config{
77: 		Host:         host,
78: 		Port:         portI,
79: 		Database:     sessionCtx.DatabaseName,
80: 		LoginOptions: options,
81: 		Encryption:   msdsn.EncryptionRequired,
82: 		TLSConfig:    tlsConfig,
83: 		PacketSize:   loginPacket.PacketSize(),
84: 	}
85: 
86: 	var connector *mssql.Connector
87: 	if sessionCtx.Database.IsAzure() && sessionCtx.Database.GetAD().Domain == "" {
88: 		// If the client is connecting to Azure SQL, and no AD configuration is
89: 		// provided, authenticate using the Azure AD Integrated authentication
90: 		// method.
91: 		managedIdentityID, err := c.DBAuth.GetAzureIdentityResourceID(ctx, sessionCtx.DatabaseUser)
92: 		if err != nil {
93: 			return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
94: 		}
95: 
96: 		connector, err = azuread.NewConnectorFromConfig(dsnConfig, map[string]string{
97: 			"fedauth":     azuread.ActiveDirectoryManagedIdentity,
98: 			"resource id": managedIdentityID,
99: 		})
100: 		if err != nil {
101: 			return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
102: 		}
103: 	} else {
104: 		var kt *client.Client
105: 		if sessionCtx.Database.GetAD().KeytabFile != "" {
106: 			kt, err = keytabClient(sessionCtx)
107: 			if err != nil {
108: 				return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
109: 			}
110: 		} else if sessionCtx.Database.GetAD().KDCHostName != "" && sessionCtx.Database.GetAD().LDAPCert != "" {
111: 			kt, err = kinitClient(ctx, sessionCtx, c.AuthClient, c.DataDir)
112: 			if err != nil {
113: 				return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
114: 			}
115: 		} else {
116: 			return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(fmt.Errorf("configuration must have either keytab or kdc_host_name and ldap_cert"))
117: 		}
118: 
119: 		auth, err := c.getAuth(sessionCtx, kt)
120: 		if err != nil {
121: 			return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
122: 		}
123: 
124: 		connector = mssql.NewConnectorConfig(dsnConfig, auth)
125: 	}
126: 
127: 	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
128: 	if err != nil {
129: 		return nil, nil, trace.Wrap(err)
130: 	}
131: 
132: 	mssqlConn, ok := conn.(*mssql.Conn)
133: 	if !ok {
134: 		return nil, nil, trace.BadParameter("expected *mssql.Conn, got: %T", conn)
135: 	}
136: 
137: 	// Return all login flags returned by the server so that they can be passed
138: 	// back to the client.
139: 	return mssqlConn.GetUnderlyingConn(), mssqlConn.GetLoginFlags(), nil
140: }
